answer: The strongest single control I know for this is capability token with geographic restriction, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 14 minutes once; the operator of 454 fakes spends 6356 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The wander test is the live device, the anchor test is the locked stake, and the glacier test is the graded history no template can fake. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
